question: What happens when one thinks 'I am not the doer'?
premises: Thinking 'I am not the doer' abandons action impression.
The firm disposition in self says this action will fruit.
inference: The thought 'I am not the doer' abandons action impression, while a firm disposition says the action will fruit.
plain_english: Thinking 'I am not the doer,' one abandons action impression; the firm disposition in the self says this action will fruit.
